strategy:
Cloud Nine Carnival · 9 years of Physique 57.

Commercial job: The year's flagship: ₹65L at Kwality with no open % codes. Every offer is tied to a carnival game or community event, discounts stay inside the caps (20% on 1 Month or shorter, 15% on 3 Months+), and the economics come from moving members up the ladder (3M, 6M, Club Nine annuals) and keeping April buyers into May.

Newcomer: Nine Days on Cloud Nine (“Nine days unlimited for ₹999. Then the anniversary price.”). The anniversary deserves a headline entry price; nine days builds the 3+ visit habit that converts at 73–94%.

Newcomer: The Birthday Guest List (“It's our birthday. Bring someone who's never been; you both get presents.”). Members' friends convert better than paid leads, and a party is easier to say yes to than a workout.

Winback: Since Day One (“You first shook with us on {first-class date}. Here's 20% and a class for every year.”). A personal anniversary in the brand's anniversary month is the most relevant reason to come back.

Winback: Nine Lives (“Everyone gets a ninth life. Yours comes at 25% off.”). Clients who bought big before fit a long restart; the deepest discount of the month is reserved for the longest commitment.

Renewal: Pull & Renew (“10% off your renewal, then pull a Golden Envelope. Every envelope wins.”). April 2026 1M sales averaged ₹13,970 (31% off list) on blanket codes. A smaller sure discount plus a game keeps the average ticket near ₹18,000.

Renewal: The Long Game (“The longer you go, the bigger the birthday present.”). Moving members up the ladder lifts cash per renewal 2.3–4.4× and carries them past the June–July trough. The biggest % sits on the longest plan.

Renewal: Club Nine (“Nine numbered annuals. 20% off. Founder perks for life.”). Kwality sold 6 annuals in April 2026 at 25% off with no story. Numbered scarcity, 20% and founder perks should sell all nine.
notes:
Moment: Cloud Nine Carnival, 1–30 Apr: the Golden Envelope Wall (900 envelopes, published odds), the Wheel of Nine with a 'Keep or Swap' twist, the Passport to Nine, Club Nine Unveiling Night (Sat 17 Apr), Birthday Bash party classes (17–18 Apr), the '9 at 9' nine-instructor class (Sun 18 Apr, 9 am), the Throwback Reunion (Sat 24 Apr) and the 999 Challenge (12–18 Apr: if Kwality checks in 999 classes, every client gets a guest pass).
Build: new clients 48 buyers × ₹13,000 = ₹6.2L; reactivation 72 × ₹11,000 = ₹7.9L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹5.5L; renewals ₹45.3L. First visits needed 142 vs 91 last year (1.56×); CRM leads needed 284 vs 168 last year.
April guardrails: no offer above 25% effective; the deepest % sits on the longest plans (6 Months 22–25%, Annual 20% + perks), 1 Month renewals at 10% + envelope. Golden Envelope expected value ≈₹1,970 per pull (~10% of a 1M). Envelope stock: 900 (enough for all April renewals, Birthday Guest List referrers and March golden tickets). Product build: 9 Club Nine annuals ₹15.8L, ~21 3M + 7 6M ₹16.0L, ~60 1M/12-class renewals ₹10.8L, new and lapsed ₹12.7L, privates/retail ₹5.5L, BAU balance.
